caption: The drawing depicts a single antique iron positioned horizontally against a plain, light beige background. The iron has a dark brown, rusted metallic surface, with significant textural detail indicating wear or age. Its body is elongated and tapers to a pointed end on the right, while the left end is squared and features a hinge and latch mechanism. The handle is arch-shaped, attached to the iron's top by two vertical supports that connect to the base via two rounded bolts or fasteners. The overall composition centers the iron in the frame, with no additional objects or markings present. The color palette consists primarily of earthy browns and muted grays, emphasizing the material and aged appearance of the iron.
title: Hand Iron
